purpose: Existing-scene production HTTP regression after the hardware integration; no browser automation or source modification.

checks: All frozen source Git blob hashes
Original Vue mount point, rejection of host SPA fallback
Local bundle responses are not HTML
Complete original GLB content hash and embedded-resource structure
Fixed upstream tree and original license
Exact published resource byte counts and SHA-256 over real production preview HTTP
Original iframe document and lifecycle adapter marker
Local fonts and required original RFTwin replay files
Expected host HTML shell for local/live deep links

limitations: These checks verify HTTP routing, source and resource delivery. They do not execute or visually inspect WebGL.
A local/live query route returning the host HTML does not certify a live backend, telemetry connection or physical equipment.
Real mobile gestures, cameras, GPU/audio resource release and physical acceptance require separate observation.
